name: Sissy Home of Evelyn
source: Francis was once a devoted husband and a dedicated employee at a high-end beauty and lotion e-commerce company. But his life takes a tragic turn when he’s falsely accused of stalking a model affiliated with his workplace. Fired without cause and dragged through the legal system by his former employer, Francis finds himself blacklisted from the industry. With his reputation shattered and no job prospects in sight, Francis must get creative to survive… and possibly clear his name. Will he rebuild his life through resilience and ingenuity, or spiral into despair? The choices are yours.
